Hi Jonas,

We tried to accept the Zip supplier invite you sent yesterday but are blocked on two things: the invite link shows a "session expired" error and when we request an OTP it bounces back immediately with a 421 SMTP bounce (our infra team saw it). We attempted from two different domains within our tenant and saw the same behavior.

Quick details: the primary user is sarah.gomez@lumenforge.com; she receives the email but the OTP message never lands — our logs show a 421 bounce from redwood-relay followed by a 302 redirect to the portal with query string "tenant=lf-prod".

I've attached a screenshot and the small log snippet we captured. We need to complete PO setup today to get invoices flowing — past-due approvals are piling up. Can you reissue the invite or advise a workaround?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear repro and logs. Sorry for the disruption.

Preliminary diagnosis: looks like an affinity cookie is binding to the tenant alias (lf-prod) and TTL is expiring before the OTP flow hits the relay. We also see a redirect to the portal without the claim parameter in the invite link which can cause a tenant mismatch for accounts authored under group aliases.

Intermediate steps I can take right now:
- Reissue a tenant-scoped invite that forces claims=tenantId in the redirect (I will do this now).
- Bypass the OTP relay for the next 30 minutes so the user can finish setup; this requires a small one-off token I can send to Sarah.

Ben, looping you in for visibility — would you prefer engineering to whitelist LumenForge IPs temporarily or should we change the invite flow?

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Quick tech note from my side (tagging Engineering):

Observations from logs (internal):
- Several 401s returned by zip-auth-service where cookie tenantId != redirect param.
- OTP relay returned 421 for messages forwarded via redwood-relay at 2026-06-15T16:08:21Z; upstream SMTP MTAs marked message as transient due to greylisting rules.

Short-term options:
1) Reissue tenant-scoped invite (preferred) — add "claims=tenant:lf-prod" to the invite redirect and shorten cookie TTL to 5 minutes for new sessions.
2) Whitelist LumenForge relay range: 54.210.0.0/16 for 1 hour (requires ops approval).
3) Provide a one-time verification code in the body (less secure) — acceptable if procurement signs off.

I'll create a Jira and link it: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RJ-1284 — Engineering can pick up with ops. Jonas, please resend the tenant-scoped invite; Sarah, reply when you accept so we can confirm.

Ben Carter
